ledger: West fruit-stall row (start-left) | red awnings, hanging red-fruit garlands, red tub of oranges, purple tub of eggs, green bin of avocados, masked vendor | identical stall content seen on the RIGHT side of frame in the final rear view | background rotates left (0-2s) -> behind subject (5-8s) -> right (9.6s), consistent with a 180° camera arc

East stall row (start-right) | blue tub of avocados, wooden crates of apples/pears, red awnings, pedestrians (red-polo woman) approaching | tubs/crates still occupy the same side as subjects pass | no side swap; pedestrians on this side remain on the correct side throughout the arc

Pedestrian aisle | straight lane between the two stall rows, receding to vanishing point under line of red umbrellas | same lane, camera now behind subject looking back down it | west-to-east crossers (blue-shirt ponytail woman, white-shirt man) enter left foreground and emerge right/background, matching the geometry

Camera | positioned south of subject, looking down aisle (front view of her) | positioned north of subject, looking south (rear view) | continuous arc via her right/east side; at 5.5s (looking west) north is frame-right and the woman's southward travel reads as frame-left, correct

Blue-shirt man with glasses | mid-frame left at 8.6s (camera heading ~SW) | frame right at 9.6s (camera heading S) | apparent left-to-right shift is exactly what his fixed west-side position predicts as the heading rotates 45°

Subject with umbrella | walking toward camera, holding red apple at chest | walking away from camera, apple no longer in frame | occlusions by crossing pedestrians and by the umbrella evolve continuously, no background-through-foreground errors
